summary.text: Travis Hackworth is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia, representing District 5, serving since 2021.
The district covers all of Bland, Giles, Pulaski, Smyth and Tazewell counties and Radford City, plus parts of Montgomery and Wythe counties.
The Senate biography lists Travis Hackworth's occupation as entrepreneur.

paragraphs.text: The biography says Travis Hackworth was born in Richlands, Virginia.
It lists Richlands Christian Academy and Southwest Virginia Community College under education.
The memberships entry lists an advisory board on National Bank and the executive board of Clinch Valley Medical Center Hospital.
Travis Hackworth serves on the Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources; Local Government; Privileges and Elections; and Transportation committees.
